review_notes: NET-NEW FINDINGS: 1 (i18n gap across NeighborsScreen/MessagesScreen/AnnouncementsScreen). This is NOT a duplicate: mobile-rn has an active i18n-remediation track (30 status==done code-review-mobile-rn-* rows, ~9 of them i18n: hardcoded-empty-error-i18n, biometric-prompt-i18n, meterdetail-i18n, voice-cmd-hardcoded-en, thread-detail-hardcoded-en, detail-back-button-hardcoded-en, outage-status-untranslated, news-personmonths-badge-untranslated, outages-news-header-chip-i18n) but NONE of them cover the Neighbors screen header/subtitle/placeholder nor the Messages/Announcements search placeholders. Confirmed via id/segment scan of backlog.json.

CLEAN (no finding): the data layer is solid. hooks/useApi.ts wraps every call in apiRequest returning Result-shaped {data,isLoading,error}; hooks/useOfflineSupport.ts is a hardened offline queue (RETRYABLE_HTTP_STATUSES={401,408,429} carried forward, 5xx never dropped, permanent-4xx surfaced to UI via permanentFailures + App.tsx Alert, strict-FIFO head-of-line blocking per issues #1767/#2637) - already thoroughly worked (matches done rows offline-401-dropped, offline-terminal-drop-dataloss, offline-permanent-4xx-silent-drop). Every list/detail screen checked (24 screens using useApiQuery) renders an explicit isLoading + error branch AND an empty-state; OutageDetailScreen/ArticleDetailScreen/VoteDetailScreen all guard `if (error || !data)` / `loadError ?`. No unhandled query. DocumentUploadScreen.tsx:172 `as unknown as Blob` is the documented RN FormData idiom (eslint-disabled + comment), not an unsafe cross-boundary cast.

NITS (skipped per SKILL 'skip nits'): console.error calls in useOfflineSupport.ts are deliberate diagnostics paired with user-visible surfacing, not debug leftovers; usePushNotifications.ts:240/267 `console.log('[push] ...')` are tagged push lifecycle logs (already captured + done as code-review-mobile-rn-push-debug-console-log). VoteDetailScreen.tsx:300 `t('voting.loadError') ?? "Couldn't load vote"` has a dead nullish fallback (react-i18next t() never returns null) - cosmetic only. No GlobalScope-equivalent leaks; deep-link listener leak already done (code-review-mobile-rn-deeplink-url-listener-leak).

evidence: frontend/apps/mobile/src/screens/neighbors/NeighborsScreen.tsx:184 - the screen header title is a hardcoded English literal `<Text style={s.headerTitle}>Neighbours</Text>`, and :187-188 the subtitle is a hardcoded English template `${visibleNeighbors.length} residents in ${buildingName}` / `${visibleNeighbors.length} residents in your building`, and :195 the search box is `placeholder="Search by name or apartment…"` - all rendered in English for every locale.
frontend/apps/mobile/src/screens/messages/MessagesScreen.tsx:125 - `placeholder="Search messages…"` hardcoded English, same i18n bypass.
frontend/apps/mobile/src/screens/announcements/AnnouncementsScreen.tsx:244 - `placeholder="Search announcements..."` hardcoded English, same i18n bypass.

Asymmetry confirming this is an accidental gap, not a deliberate opt-out: all three files are otherwise fully internationalized. NeighborsScreen imports useTranslation (:13), binds `const {t}=useTranslation()` (:123) and uses t() for its loading (:164), load-error (:173), retry (:175) and empty-state (:214/:217) strings - only the header, subtitle and placeholder were missed. MessagesScreen uses {t( 7x and AnnouncementsScreen 6x elsewhere; only their search placeholders are hardcoded.

Severity LOW (+1), i18n gap: @ppt/mobile is a react-i18next app with src/locales per-language bundles; these user-facing header/subtitle/search-placeholder strings render in fixed English regardless of the active locale. Confidence medium - the hardcoded literals and the absence of t() are confirmed by static read; whether a non-English locale is actively selected at runtime is config-dependent. Net-new: the mobile-rn i18n-remediation track (9 done i18n rows) does not include the Neighbors screen or the Messages/Announcements search placeholders. Fix: wrap in t() with new keys (e.g. neighbors.title / neighbors.subtitle with count+building interpolation / neighbors.searchPlaceholder, messages.searchPlaceholder, announcements.searchPlaceholder) and add them to the locale bundles.
